resources.name: Stuttgart energy-consistent small-core pseudopotentials for Ac–Lr

access.notes: Pseudopotential parameters and basis sets are available from the Stuttgart library.
Basis sets distributed with the pseudopotential library; also accessible via the basis set exchange.
Install via pip. Provides state‑averaged CASSCF, ACPF, and effective core potential support including spin‑orbit.
